page.title: System
page.description: Scheduled reboot, modem identity, optional services and factory reset.

describe.every_hours_uneven_one: Every hour from midnight, then again at midnight
describe.every_hours_uneven_other: Every {{count}} hours from midnight, then again at midnight

validation.interval: Choose an interval that divides the day: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24 hours.
validation.day_of_month: The day of the month must be 1 to 31.

imei.luhn_mismatch: The check digit does not match (Luhn): this is not a valid IMEI.
imei.invalid: The IMEI must be 15 digits with a valid check digit

dialog.confirm_description: The modem identity changes after the next restart. Note the current IMEI before continuing.
dialog.written_description: Restart the modem now to use the new IMEI?

esim.title: eSIM Manager
esim.description: Runs the local euicc-client service behind the eSIM page (profiles on SIM 2).
esim.client_missing: The euicc-client is not installed ({{path}}), so the eSIM manager cannot be enabled. It is not part of SimpleAdmin: copy it to the modem as described in docs/Enable_New_feature.md.

toast.failed: Unable to change the eSIM manager

factory_reset.title: Factory Reset
factory_reset.description: Removes band and cell locks, sets automatic network mode, restores the LAN, firewall and IPA configuration, the system and web passwords and simpleadmin.conf, then reboots.

dialog.title: Reset to factory defaults?
dialog.description: Every setting listed above is lost and the modem reboots. Afterwards it answers at 192.168.225.1 with the default credentials.
